descriptions.browse_file: Browse all symbols in a file - the outline view, with filtering, sorting and optional stats. Example invocation: {"file": "src/server/server.cpp", "kind": "function", "sort": "line"}
descriptions.callers: Who calls this symbol? A resolved call-graph query: confirmed callers grouped by enclosing function with call-site lines and counts, unresolved sites kept separate. Example invocation: {"name": "IndexDirectory", "max": 50}
descriptions.code_insight: Codebase-wide intelligence: overview, detailed analysis, statistics, structure and git analysis, selected by mode. Example invocation: {"mode": "overview", "scope": "src", "max_results": 20}
descriptions.context: Capture and hydrate code context manifests for agent handoff - 'save' writes a compact manifest, 'load' hydrates it with source and call graphs. Example invocation: {"operation": "save", "task": "port the indexer", "refs": [{"f": "src/index/indexer.cpp", "s": "IndexDirectory", "role": "modify"}], "to_file": "handoff.json"}
descriptions.debug_info: Deep debug information for index troubleshooting: symbol distribution, type breakdown, reference statistics and file-level detail. Example invocation: {"mode": "references", "file_path": "src/index/indexer.cpp", "verbose": true}
descriptions.find_files: Like 'find' or 'fd' - searches file paths, not content, on an in-memory index, with fuzzy matching, globs and filters. Example invocation: {"pattern": "*_test.go", "directory": "internal", "max": 20}
descriptions.get_context: Detailed context for specific code objects: signature, file path, line numbers, callers and callees, references, source excerpt and snippets. Example invocation: {"id": "4211", "include_call_hierarchy": true}
descriptions.git_analysis: Analyze git changes for duplicates, naming inconsistencies and function complexity before you commit. Example invocation: {"scope": "staged", "focus": ["duplicates"], "max_findings": 25}
descriptions.index_stats: Index status and health: indexing progress, component health, memory usage and file-watcher status. Example invocation: {"mode": "health", "include_memory": true}
descriptions.info: Detailed help and examples for any tool - an overview, or specifics for one tool. Example invocation: {"tool": "search"}
descriptions.inspect_symbol: Deep inspect a single symbol: signature, doc, complexity, callers, callees, type hierarchy, scope chain, flags and a bounded source excerpt. Example invocation: {"name": "SymbolStore", "include": "callers,callees"}
descriptions.list_symbols: Enumerate and filter symbols in the index - the 'ls' for code - by kind, file, complexity, parameters and exported status. Example invocation: {"kind": "function", "min_complexity": 10, "exported": true, "max": 50}
descriptions.search: Sub-millisecond in-memory semantic code search, grouped per file with per-hit line numbers; symbol hits carry an id that feeds get_context. Example invocation: {"pattern": "NewRouter", "path": "internal", "max": 20}
descriptions.semantic_annotations: Query symbols by semantic label or category, including labels propagated through call graphs. Example invocation: {"label": "auth", "include_propagated": true, "max_results": 50}
descriptions.side_effects: Query function purity and side effects: writes to parameters, globals and closures, I/O and exception handling, optionally transitive. Example invocation: {"symbol_name": "IndexDirectory", "include_transitive": true, "include_reasons": true}
